verdicts.reason: Both use the same weak four-column 728x90 layout. The six-line headline is crammed into three dense lines with no breathing room, and the body copy is shrunk into a five-line block of roughly 7px text that you can't read at banner size. The 'Reserve a Case' button and 'Ships late June' are tiny and jammed against the right edge, 'LIMITED SUMMER RELEASE' is cut off from the headline it introduces, and the orange divider is gone. The only difference is the logo: A's is larger and reads better inside the white panel, while B's is shrunk to a small mark lost in empty white space, so A is marginally better.
